info.name: Dell Servers Dell iDRAC Redfish REST Accounts Telemetry Service API

items.docs: Retrieves the telemetry service resource which provides access to metric definitions and metric report definitions for server telemetry data including power, thermal, CPU, memory, and NIC statistics.
Retrieves the collection of metric reports available from the telemetry service. Each report contains a set of related metrics that can be streamed via SSE or polled directly.
